summary: Full migration of legacy minigames to Arcade system, resolved InteractionNotReplied Discord lifecycle bug, updated /core help and command registry, verified audio/music voice connection mutex, IMDb movie/anime search relevance, Minecraft canvas multi-provider fallback cascade, and safe total message cleanup.

resolvedIssues.symptom: DiscordjsError [InteractionNotReplied]: The reply to this interaction has not been sent or deferred at claimDaily / showHub
resolvedIssues.rootCause: Subcommand routing executed editReply() without prior deferReply() or reply(). Button and select menu callbacks also failed when undeferred.
resolvedIssues.solution: 1. Injected auto-deferral in execute() before routing. 2. Created unified respond() helper handling both replied/deferred and unacknowledged states. 3. Wrapped interaction.editReply in wrapInteractionSafe (interactionCreate.js) to automatically redirect to reply() when undeferred across the entire bot. 4. Registered button and select menu handlers in src/interactions/buttons/arcade.js and src/interactions/selects/arcadeSelect.js.

resolvedIssues.symptom: Legacy /minigame command existed alongside new Arcade system, causing confusion and duplicate engines.
resolvedIssues.solution: Migrated all 16 game engines and shared helpers to plugin/arcade/subcommands/ and plugin/arcade/helpers/, deleted plugin/minigames/ directory completely, and replaced /minigame with /arcade in /core help (src/core/helpView.js) and src/services/commandRegistry.js.

resolvedIssues.symptom: Native intro speech and Lavalink music player collided on voice gateway, causing aborts and stuttering.
resolvedIssues.solution: Implemented voice connection mutex in VoiceManager (acquireVoiceLock, releaseVoiceLock, handoverToMusic, yieldToMusic) and pre-buffering delay in MusicManager.

resolvedIssues.symptom: n!movie and n!anime returned irrelevant TV shows (e.g. Counting Cars instead of Cars 2).
resolvedIssues.solution: Integrated IMDb Suggestions API as primary provider for movies with exact title weighting and year proximity; added fuzzy/exact scoring in AniList/Kitsu/Jikan for anime.

resolvedIssues.symptom: Minecraft skin canvas failed with empty black squares when external providers had rate limits or downtime.
resolvedIssues.solution: Built 4-tier provider fallback cascade (mc-heads.net -> minotar.net -> crafatar.com -> local offline Steve/Alex buffers).

resolvedIssues.symptom: Cleaning messages sometimes left empty ghost containers or failed with Unknown Message 10008.
resolvedIssues.solution: Standardized safeDeleteMessage with defensive Discord error suppression (10008, 10015, 10062, 50027) and cleanGhostContainers filter.
